name: Graphite
reference: Linear's launch films and site: a quiet graphite interface, 1 px borders, real UI at readable size.
pattern: Graphite ground, white type, a grey scale, one green for the one thing that matters.
personality: A calm, dense product shown honestly. The UI is the hero; the camera tilts slightly.

motion.character: UI builds in 250-400 ms; panels slide on a slight 3D tilt; cuts land on the beat.
motion.transitions: Cut on the beat, or the camera glides to the next panel.

texture.note: A very fine grain. Borders are 1 px; never glowing.

grammar: Real UI, shown at a readable size, is the subject.
A headline sits above or beside the UI, never over it.
The accent marks one element per scene.
needs: Real screenshots, or the real UI built with uiWindow (the product's own names, rows and states). A built window counts as real UI: a product with no screenshots needs none.

pictures.note: Real UI screenshots, ungraded, in a window with a 1 px border; or the UI itself, built with uiWindow from the product's real names and states (a built window counts as real UI). The camera tracks the cursor.

footage.note: Screen recordings of the real product, ungraded.

music.feel: calm ambient electronic, warm pads, restrained

hits.note: A soft click only on a real cursor click on screen.

hook.how: Real, dense UI at a readable size on frame 0, with the headline in its slot above it.

compose.how: The line at the text-safe top; the window under it is a graphic, so it may run past the text-safe sides to cover the hook's share. At 9:16 the window (uiWindow with no box) fills 59 % of the frame: the picture-safe width, from one gap under a two-line line to the picture-safe foot. It is filled with rows to the text-safe foot (never an empty panel: 5 one-line rows, or 3 two-line rows with a detail), the list runs on under the fold as row rules with no text, and the rows' text keeps to the text-safe area, the low band's right edge included. A second screen of the app replaces the first in the same box.

moves.move: The camera glides between panels with a slight 3D tilt that eases back to 0 at rest; the UI never empties for the move.

measurable.how: A sentence and the UI stay on screen through every glide.

moves.move: UI builds in 250-400 ms, and cuts land on the beat.

measurable.how: Cuts sit within 2 frames of a beat.

moves.move: The accent marks one element per scene.

measurable.how: The accent covers one connected region per key frame.

props.tiltX: a slight tilt, 4-6 degrees, back to 0 at rest

blocks.for: The glide to the next panel.

props.pinned: true, so the headline rides through the glides

blocks.for: The headline in a fixed slot, changed by a cut on the beat.

props.title: the view's name
props.rows: the list it shows: the rows fill the window to its foot (never an empty panel); give no box, so the window takes the system's (windowBox: under the line, to the text-safe foot, across the picture-safe width) and a second screen keeps it
props.sidebar: its width, when the app has one
props.replaces: the window this screen follows: the frame stays, the old content leaves and the new enters, never both at once
props.enter: "cut" for a hard change of screen

blocks.for: The app window: 1 px borders, the system's own head (a title and a rule, a tab strip, or none), its rows. No title-bar dots. A second screen of the same window replaces the first.

props.badge: a status (tone "accent" on the one row that matters)
props.selected: the row the cursor picks: one row at a time (uiWindow rows throws on two; multi: true for a list that selects many)

blocks.for: Dense rows that fit their names, given to uiWindow as `rows`; the selected one has the accent bar and says state "selected".

props.path: the points it moves to; `to` a part's id to click it clear of its text

blocks.for: One continuous action that clicks; with button, tab and toast from the ui kit.

avoid.why: A product film shows the product working, not a chart.

wanted.name: ui sidebar list
wanted.for: A sidebar with sections and counts, and avatars with pictures; the ui kit has the window, rows with initials and a cursor.

ends.how: The last action completes (a count ticks to its end state), and the window settles with the name and line above it.
ends.with: the last click completes the action on the last bar; the window holds with the name above it

mix.note: Calm electronic; cuts on its beats. A click only on a real cursor click.

shots.match: One product: every screen from the same app, in the same theme and at the same scale.

subjectsToAvoid: Fibonacci numbers or the golden spiral
FizzBuzz or a sort of ten numbers
a kanban board with no story
